name: gizza-ai/dns-message-parser
summary: Decode a DNS wire-format message from hex or base64url

tool.description: Decode a DNS protocol message (RFC 1035 wire format) given as hex or base64url into the 12-byte header (id, QR, opcode, AA/TC/RD/RA/AD/CD flags, RCODE, counts), the question section, and the answer/authority/additional resource records — decompressing domain names and decoding A/AAAA/NS/CNAME/PTR/MX/TXT/SOA/SRV/CAA/OPT records. Returns JSON. Runs locally.

message.description: The DNS message bytes as a hex string OR base64url (the format DNS-over-HTTPS uses in the GET ?dns= parameter), starting at the 12-byte header. For hex, spaces, colons, dashes, dots, commas, and a 0x prefix are ignored, e.g. a response begins '1234 8180 0001 0001 ...'.
